text: {"overall_winner": "B", "qualities": [{"evidence": "Essay B uses a clear thesis with parallel supporting reasons ('resiliency, and courage') and develops each in its own paragraph; Essay A repeats the same point loosely across many paragraphs.", "quality": "Organizational structure", "description": "The essay presents a clear thesis and develops each supporting point in a dedicated paragraph, giving it a coherent overall architecture."}, {"evidence": "Phrases like 'assists in keeping resiliency', 'confront everything that comes their way', 'accomplishing goals', 'surround myself with positive people'", "quality": "Lexical range and precision", "description": "The essay draws on a broader and more precise vocabulary to express abstract ideas."}, {"evidence": "Essay B uses a personal anecdote (grandmother's quote, homelessness, crossing the border) integrated as supporting evidence; Essay A's personal story is tacked on at the end.", "quality": "Integration of personal narrative", "description": "Personal experience is woven into the argument as supporting evidence rather than appended as a separate digression."}, {"evidence": "Essay B maintains consistent formal register and topic focus throughout; Essay A shifts into informal complaints ('I'm sick and tired of seeing these kind of students').", "quality": "Consistent tone and register", "description": "The essay sustains a controlled, purposeful tone without drifting into informal or off-topic commentary."}, {"evidence": "Essay B has fewer grammatical errors and more correct complex constructions; Essay A has pervasive errors like 'makes them to proud', 'build it by theirsleves', 'compare to their parents'.", "quality": "Grammatical control", "description": "The essay demonstrates more accurate and fluent control of grammar and sentence construction."}]}
